doc: Multiple micronutrient powders for point-of-use fortification of foods consumed by children 6–23 months of age

entries.claim: 在2岁以下或5岁以下儿童贫血患病率≥20%的人群中，建议对6-23月龄婴幼儿使用含铁微量营养素粉进行即用型食物强化，以改善铁状况和减少贫血。
entries.source_doc: Multiple micronutrient powders for point-of-use fortification of foods consumed by children 6–23 months of age
